verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an AI-teammate SaaS like Lindy, but the evidence pack documents no official command-line tool. The `/lindy` Slack slash commands are a chat-app command interface, not a CLI. The shell commands Lindy runs are its own internal execution, not a user-facing CLI. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
